supported_domain.variants: SNVs and anchored one-base insertions/deletions; one concrete ALT followed by <NON_REF>.
supported_domain.reference_blocks: One-base REF and <NON_REF> ALT with explicit inclusive END; nonoverlapping source spans; source gaps remain unknown.
supported_domain.phase_handling: Retain observed diploid GT separator and optional declared phase fields; no phase confidence, cis/trans or haplotype inference.

known_issues: Structural subset qualification with synthetic fixtures only; no actual HaplotypeCaller execution or full output-compatibility claim.
Caller and reference declarations are retained provenance, not proof of the generating executable or reference sequence.
No BGZF/BCF, multiple samples, alternate contig aliases, non-autosomal domains, multiallelic concrete variants or general indels.
No actual reference concordance, normalization, PL transformation, joint genotyping, global callability or negative findings.
Unconsumed INFO annotations are retained after syntax checks without scientific validation.
No interpretation, reporting, default pipeline activation or release authorization.
